result.content: # Complete the required API and report.

Stage 1: state_transitions; work sample 0.
Implement evaluate(request, policy). Return {ok, value, reason}. Look up from>to in policy.edges. Missing edges are blocked. Enforce each edge's role before retry checks. A retry needs an actual integer attempts (not bool), in [0, retry_limit). On success value is to and reason is ok. On failure value is null and reason is blocked, permission, or retry_limit. Do not modify inputs.
Write work.py with this API. Also write report.json as a JSON array of evaluate results for requests.json, using current policy.json and evidence.json when present. Keep prior supported behavior. Use actual local checks. Store findings and unresolved limits for the next agent.

command:
import copy,json
from work import evaluate
p={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'}},'retry_limit':2}
cases=[({'from':'a','to':'b'}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','retry':True,'attempts':99}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'c','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':-1}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})]
for req,want in cases:
 rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(req,p); assert got==want,(req,got,want); assert req==rb and p==pb
with open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: pol=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,pol) for r in rs]
print('all checks passed')
